# minimum population

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:minimumPopulation`](gmeow-minimumPopulation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/minimumPopulation>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/aggregation`](../../slices/aggregation.md)

The minimum population size (k) required for the aggregation result to be disclosed — the k-anonymity parameter. A result failing this check is suppressed at projection time (coarsen or withhold, [Principle 10](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-10)), never deleted.
